description: Add comprehensive project documentation: README with setup instructions, architecture overview, development guide, contributing guidelines, and deployment guide. Also add CI configuration with GitHub Actions for build/test/lint.
steps: Create README.md at root with: project description (WorldNest Online - cozy pixel-art MMO life simulation), tech stack overview, monorepo structure diagram, quick start instructions (prerequisites: Node.js 22+, pnpm 10+; setup: clone, pnpm install, copy .env.example, pnpm dev), available scripts, architecture overview (ECS game engine, chunk streaming, Supabase realtime), and links to other docs.

Create CONTRIBUTING.md with: development workflow, branch naming conventions (feat/, fix/, chore/), commit message format (conventional commits), PR process, code style (TypeScript strict, ESLint/Prettier), testing requirements.

Create docs/ARCHITECTURE.md with: high-level system diagram (client/server split), ECS engine design, chunk streaming algorithm, multiplayer sync approach (client prediction + server authority via Supabase), state management (Zustand stores), rendering pipeline (Phaser scenes), database schema overview.

Create docs/DEVELOPMENT.md with: detailed development setup, environment variables explanation, how to add new game systems (components + systems in ECS), how to add new tile types, how to extend the world generator, how to add new UI features.
Create .github/workflows/ci.yml: GitHub Actions workflow that runs on push/PR to main - steps: checkout, setup pnpm, install deps, run lint, run build, run tests. Use Node.js 22 and pnpm 10.
Create a Dockerfile at root for containerized builds: multi-stage build that installs deps, builds all packages, and produces the Next.js standalone output. This validates the full build pipeline.
Ensure all packages have proper exports in their package.json files and that cross-package imports work correctly.
acceptance_criteria: README.md exists with clear setup instructions that a developer can follow
CONTRIBUTING.md exists with development workflow guidelines
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md exists with system design documentation
docs/DEVELOPMENT.md exists with detailed development guide
.github/workflows/ci.yml exists with a valid GitHub Actions workflow
Dockerfile exists and docker build succeeds (validates full build pipeline)
All documentation references correct file paths and commands that actually work
verification: Run 'pnpm build' to confirm build still works after any package.json export changes
Run 'pnpm test' to confirm tests still pass
Run 'docker build -t worldnest-online:test .' to verify Dockerfile builds successfully
Verify CI workflow YAML is valid by checking its structure
